class.name: astribot_s1_manipulation/OmplPlannerExtension
class.description: OMPL planner manager that additionally registers the planners MoveIt2 Humble does not register out of the box: BITstar, InformedRRTstar, ABITstar, AITstar and SORRTstar. Behaves like ompl_interface/OMPLPlanner in every other respect.
